tagline: Premier hospitality REIT for group-oriented, destination hotel assets
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue of $2.577B in 2025 reflecting combined growth from Hospitality (83%) and Entertainment (17%) segments, with a 10.2% year-over-year increase

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues from Hospitality and Entertainment segments
kpis.description: Total revenue combining hospitality and entertainment operations

kpis.name: Hospitality Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by Gaylord Hotels, JW Marriott properties, Inn at Opryland and AC Hotel
kpis.description: Hospitality segment revenue, representing 83% of total revenue in 2025 and 85% in 2024

kpis.name: Entertainment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from Grand Ole Opry, Ryman Auditorium, Ole Red, Category 10, Block 21 and other entertainment assets
kpis.description: Entertainment segment revenue (Opry Entertainment Group), representing 17% of total revenue with accelerated growth

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Stable operating income despite revenue growth, revealing a 13.1% increase in expenses

kpis.name: Net Income per Share (Diluted)
kpis.explanation: Net income available to common stockholders divided by diluted shares outstanding
kpis.description: Diluted net income per share of $3.77 in 2025, impacted by the issuance of 3.0 million shares in May 2025
kpis.signal: Per share dilution from equity issuance

kpis.name: Total Hotel Rooms
kpis.explanation: Total number of rooms across all owned and managed hotel properties
kpis.description: Portfolio of 11,869 rooms consisting of 5 Gaylord Hotels properties, 2 JW Marriott properties, Inn at Opryland and AC Hotel
kpis.signal: Stable portfolio after JW Marriott Desert Ridge acquisition

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investment in existing properties and improvements
kpis.description: Capital expenditures of $358.2M in 2025 for improvements and maintenance of existing properties

kpis.name: Cash Distributions Declared
kpis.explanation: Dividends declared to stockholders reflecting REIT distribution policy
kpis.description: Cash distributions declared of $291.3M in 2025 in line with REIT dividend policy of 100% of taxable income
kpis.signal: Growing distributions aligned with taxable income
